review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 11, 4:26 AM ET. It had Maldives 28%, the draw 27% and India 46%, projecting Maldives 1.2 – India 1.6 (2.7 total, India by 0.4).

Final: Maldives 0 – India 1. Right winner: it had India at 46%.

Thin data: 2 of 6 key inputs were sourced (missing: MDV goals scored, MDV goals allowed, MDV lineup rating or past seasons, IND lineup rating or past seasons), so league averages filled the gaps. It was logged as a no-data call: graded and learned from, never offered as a bet.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Maldives came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 11 and 11 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.2, they scored 0 (−1.2 goals, 100% under); projected to allow 1.6, they allowed 1 (−0.6 goals, 36% under).

India came in with a 9% above average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (1-0-0, 3 scored and 2 allowed a game over 1 games), worth about 12 and 12 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.6, they scored 1 (−0.6 goals, 36% under); projected to allow 1.2, they allowed 0 (−1.2 goals, 100% under).

The bigger miss was Maldives' scoring (-1.2 goals against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.body:
Total: 1 against 2.7 projected (-1.7), about the 15th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: India by 1 against India by 0.4 projected, about the 64th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.body: Form (MDV 0-5 L5 · IND 1-3 L5): India ×0.98, Maldives ×0.94. It favored India, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.body:

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.441 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +0.6 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).
